infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: OpenTeam uses the camera only when you choose to take a photo for a message.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: OpenTeam connects to the self-hosted server you choose on your local network.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OpenTeam records voice notes when you choose the microphone and sends them to your server for transcription.
